assertions.assertion: The claim is for CPT code 93226
CPT code 93226 is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
CO-22 indicates that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias that may be contributing to the patient's recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary given the patient's presentation and history
